### Main benchmark — AUROC by predictor

Every predictor is computed from the *same* execution traces, so the comparison differs only in the feature used. AUROC is tie-aware Wilcoxon–Mann–Whitney; the interval is a cluster bootstrap resampling base programs; the p-value permutes labels within clusters.

**Published protocol** — split `test`, protocol `published`
